items.title: JJ Johnson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: The interviewer mentions 'Jay Bird' in the context of a recording and a solo, but the interviewee (JJ Johnson) does not respond with any personal anecdote, confirmation of meeting, or description of a relationship. The mention is purely contextual/narrative by the interviewer.

ctx.x: Jay Jay and Jay Bird. Fact is, the trombone player with Lionel Hampton on one of the recordings played your solo, the one from Jay Bird. [Baker sings the opening measures of the solo.] I remember thinking, "This is really wild," because it wasn’t the standard thing, like they did later on with – what’s that group that plays Bird’s music?
